title: Dependency upgrades invalidate qualification until re-verification
blocker: There is no production compatibility catalog and release workflow that binds and monitors exact kernel, QEMU, firmware, policy, device firmware, guest and driver digests.
assertions: every supported profile binds exact dependency versions and retained qualification evidence hashes
an observed dependency digest or signer change invalidates all affected supported claims
invalidated profiles are denied by API, scheduler, host agent and launcher until re-qualified
unrelated profiles remain available when their complete dependency set is unchanged
